issue: #7067 (mixing-via-embeddings); math-generality follow-up locking the two open caveats (rav directive 2026-07-19)
why: The math-generality axis-1 (seed 0, e in {4,8,16,32}, 10B) showed decisive linear-past-threshold harm (harm(e32)=+1.92 bpb, 21 sigma_pair; b_math=0.091; tau_math=10.83) BUT left TWO caveats open: (1) tau-universality -- tau_math=10.83 is single-seed and HIGHER than code tau=8.85; is tau UNIVERSAL or PER-BUCKET? (2) curvature -- math's e32/e16 ratio R=4.09 admits a PHYSICAL ratio-matching quadratic (tau_quad=0.36), and the single-seed e8 point cannot exclude mild curvature. This follow-up adds 4 seed replicates at the ratio points (e16,e32 x seeds {1,2}) to pool a 3-seed tau CI, and 2 dense low/mid points (e6 sub-threshold, e12 just-above-onset, seed 1) to discriminate LINEAR from mildly-CURVED.
design_note: Reuses launch_mve_mathgen_h100.py EXACTLY: bucket c02q0 (math) @ FIXED w=0.2 both phases + c05q0 (web) @ 0.8 (never epochs); content h=V.w CONSTANT across runs (frozen content kernel FLAT); real epochs via max_train_batches (target_budget OFF); 10B = 4776 steps, boundary 3776; d512 swarm + gpu_fa4_cute; gsm8k bpb readout. Only the epoch grid points and the seeds differ. n = round(w*boundary/e) = round(755.2/e) -- the SAME rule as the axis (e4/e8/e16/e32 -> 189/94/47/24). ANCHOR for harm is the axis-1 seed-0 e4 checkpoint (rav_mve_mathgen_e4); content is frozen so a single shared e4 anchor is valid, and the pair SE already carries the anchor's seed noise.

constants.epoching_mechanism: max_train_batches (REAL subset-repeat; budgets OFF) -- == mathgen axis-1 / twobucket-a2 / epochrep / harm100b
constants.optimizer: SWARM_OPTIMIZER fractional schedule (warmup peak 0.100*N; asserted at launch for N=4776)
constants.hardware: cw-rno2a H100x8 one node/run, cuda_async allocator, CW-mirror data, DEFAULT (interactive) priority -- queues behind, never preempts, the non-preemptible 100B gate

seed_floor.source: 10-seed panel rav_mve_seedpanel_h100 (gsm8k bpb per-run SD ddof=1); seedpanel_readout per_task

linear_form.note: committed axis-1 linear form (b=0.091, tau=10.83). harm(e6)=0 (sub-threshold); harm(e12)=0.106; harm(e16)=0.470; harm(e32)=1.926.

quadratic_ratio_matched.anchored_on: axis-1 seed-0 realized harm(e16)=0.468905, harm(e32)=1.918770 (reproduces both by construction)
quadratic_ratio_matched.note: the physical ratio-matching quadratic the single-seed e8 could not exclude. Materially >0 at the dense points: harm(e6)=0.061, harm(e12)=0.260.

discriminator_gaps.note: e6: linear 0.000 vs quadratic 0.061 (gap 0.061 = 0.68 pairSE) -- soft single-seed discriminator. e12: linear 0.106 vs quadratic 0.260 (gap 0.154 = 1.72 pairSE) -- the stronger dense discriminator. Power mainly comes from the tighter linear line the 3-seed e16/e32 fit gives (b, tau CI shrink), against which e6+e12 residuals are tested.

decision_rule.i_tau_universality: Pool axis-1 seed-0 + axis-2 seeds {1,2} at e16 and e32 (3 seeds each). harm(e)=mean_bpb(e over 3 seeds) - bpb(e4 seed-0 anchor). Monte-Carlo propagate bpb(e4)~N(.,sigma), bpb(e16|e32)~N(., sigma/sqrt(3)); tau=(32-16R)/(1-R), R=harm(e32)/harm(e16) -> pooled 3-seed tau_math CI. If the CI EXCLUDES code tau=8.85 -> tau is PER-BUCKET (model needs a per-bucket tau). If it INCLUDES 8.85 -> tau plausibly UNIVERSAL.
decision_rule.ii_curvature: Realized harm(e6) vs the 2sqrt(2)sigma floor (0.179): harm(e6) < 0.179 (~0) -> LINEAR confirmed (hinge/threshold real); harm(e6) >> 0.179 -> mild CURVATURE (early onset). e12 corroborates: on the linear line (0.106) -> LINEAR; near the quadratic (0.260) -> curved. Point estimates over the tighter 3-seed linear line sharpen the residual test even where each dense point is single-seed.
decision_rule.verdict: Two independent locks. (1) tau UNIVERSAL iff the pooled 3-seed tau_math CI includes 8.85; PER-BUCKET iff it excludes it. (2) form LINEAR iff harm(e6)~0 (< floor) and harm(e12) on the linear line; mildly CURVED iff e6/e12 track the ratio-matching quadratic.

readout_plan.eval: post-hoc eval_logprob (run_seedpanel_evals.py --only-tasks logprob_gsm8k_5shot,agieval_sat_math_0shot) on the 6 final checkpoints (step 4775); jobs rav-mve-mathgen2-eval-<point>, H100x1, LMEVAL overlay via uv run --with (== harm100b/mathgen axis-1).
readout_plan.collect: collect_seedpanel_evals.py --runs rav_mve_mathgen2_{e16s1,e16s2,e32s1,e32s2,e6s1,e12s1} --out-name mathgen2_eval_results_combined.json; also re-read axis-1 rav_mve_mathgen_{e4,e16,e32} for the pool + anchor.
